summary.text: Rory Taylor is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Samantha Fett.
He ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Fett, receiving 40.6 percent of the vote.
